name: pathomitra-promotion-website
description: Standalone, static-only public marketing site for PathoMitra. Contains no auth, session, or backend-dependent code. IMPORTANT: run npm install / npm run scripts from the parent repo — react, react-dom, react-router-dom, motion, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, tailwindcss, vite and the Vite plugins are resolved from the parent node_modules. Do NOT run npm install inside this folder; it declares no dependencies of its own.
